The '''Keresia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Keresia]].<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Keresia system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-7.<ref name="TEA" />
